segments.source: Cadorna Barista Plus is the Cadorna for someone who wants saved coffee preferences and a proper manual milk task. Four profiles and a ten-position ceramic grinder support automatic coffee preparation, while the two-hole stainless wand leaves texture and pouring to the owner. That division gives a shared kitchen convenience without an automatic milk container, provided someone is willing to learn steaming and clean the wand promptly. The reviewed North American model is RI9601/47. The historical URL's RI9603/47 code belongs to Cadorna Milk, so the listing and rating plate need to follow the corrected identity rather than the route text.
